metadata.provenanceNote: Items and boundaries established from raw video frames and stitched 10x25 canvas. 39 items independently cross-verified against official catalog screenshots in assets/items/catalog_screenshots and verified source card registry. Machine candidates were strictly separated and not copied as ground truth. The annotated frames at 158-168s show the settlement screen. Admitted crops are settlement-origin visual templates only; they are not auction-time facts and must not be backfilled into the source match.
